# Sign-in brand assets

These files were downloaded unchanged from the providers on 2026-10-16.
They are trademarks of their respective owners, not CPC Hub artwork.

- `steam-sign-in.png`: Valve's [official OpenID sign-in button](https://steamcommunity.com/dev), [original PNG](https://community.fastly.steamstatic.com/public/images/signinthroughsteam/sits_01.png). Displayed at its original 180 × 35 size, including the non-affiliation notice.
- `discord-clyde-white.svg`: Discord's white Clyde symbol from its [brand assets](https://discord.com/branding), [original SVG](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6257adef93867e50d84d30e2/66e3d7f4ef6498ac018f2c55_Symbol.svg). Displayed with the Discord name on a Blurple (`#5865F2`) button. The button layout is CPC Hub's; Discord supplies the logo and color.

Keep the images' proportions and artwork unchanged. Serve them locally through
Django static files; the Wasabi bucket holds user uploads only.
